published_source: Figures.do line 283: reghdfe log_hours_W F*event L*event if sample_A==1, a(id crawl_month) cluster(id); leads F1-F6 (evt_time = -1..-6), lags L0-L36 unbinned, omitted = evt_time < -6 and never-treated; event_plot trimmed to +/-6. Coefficients are reported only graphically; the authors' path re-run in Stata is in ~/did_packages/_work/mnsc.2022.01820/authors_eventstudies.csv and in the replication log.
column: sample A panel, sub-panel (b) high-demand day
notes: Outcome: log hours to Shufersal's earliest delivery slot, Wednesday crawl (high-demand day). sample_A: treated pre-entry monopolies (mono==1) plus all never-entered control markets (control==1). gvar Ei = month of first rival entry (NA for never-entered controls). Authors normalise to the pooled bin evt_time < -6 (no -1 reference) and leave lags unbinned to +36 (max observed +31); run_spec.R uses reference -1, bins at -7 and 7, and averages 0..6 (post) and -6..-2 (pre). fixest reproduces the authors' coefficient path exactly (log).

event_structure.source: Programs/Figures.do lines 261-283: reghdfe log_hours_W F*event L*event if sample_A==1, a(id crawl_month) cluster(id); F`l'event = 1[evt_time == -l] for l = 1..6, L`l'event = 1[evt_time == l] for l = 0..36 (L31-L36 are empty in this sample, so the bins stop at 30); event months < -6 pooled with never-treated markets are the omitted category (article: 'Reference Period: More Than 6 Months Before Entry'); event_plot trims the figure to -6..6, so the reported bins are -6..-1 and 0..6. evt_time = crawl_month - Ei = rel on every treated row (months 679-714 consecutive; earliest entry 683, no pre-sample adopters).
event_structure.verified: fixest with this structure (es_assign) on the authors' sample reproduces the 19 exported reghdfe coefficients (F1-F6, L0-L12 in ~/did_packages/_work/mnsc.2022.01820/authors_eventstudies.csv), max abs diff 6.08e-15 (SE 9.65e-14), N 3809 = reghdfe.

event_structure_vs_static_nov2: The Table 2 static specs drop event months -2/-1 (anticipation rule, onset Ei_shift2); this event spec keeps them as the reported lead bins -2 and -1 and, like the authors, normalizes to event months < -6 plus never-treated markets, so its pre summary includes the anticipation months.
